newsitem.title: INDIA: India's IDBI in $150 mln syndicated loan.
newsitem.headline: India's IDBI in $150 mln syndicated loan.

text.p: India's leading term lending institution, the Industrial Development Bank of India (IDBI) said on Tuesday it had signed a $150 million syndicated loan facility with a group of eight arranging banks.
The seven-year loan facility was signed on November 18, IDBI said in a statement.
The loan has a coupon of 60 basis points over US dollar six-month LIBOR (London Inter Bank Offered Rate). It will have put and call options at the end of five years, IDBI said.
It said the Indian government had approved a foreign currency borrowing limit of $550 million for IDBI during financial 1996/97 (April-March).
IDBI has raised $330 million so far, including the current loan and is considering various alternatives to raise the balance $220 million in the rest of the current year, the statement said.
